fusions.name: Silt Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays wet silt in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Skimming Run
fusions.desc: Skims a flat stone that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then skips to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Mud Glaze
fusions.desc: Coats you in slick mud, raising your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 10% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Shingle
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
